meta.title: GRN-to-Invoice 3-Way Match Trigger: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Open or execute the GRN-to-Invoice 3-Way Match Trigger on a posted GRN
Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify the trigger is refused or absent
Repeat the trigger as an AP Executive and verify it is available
Inspect or record tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are granted access
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or execute the GRN-to-Invoice 3-Way Match Trigger on a posted GRN; Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify the trigger is refused or absent; Repeat the trigger as an AP Executive and verify it is available; Inspect or record tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are granted access

args.need: sign in as a user without the AP Executive role, try the GRN-to-Invoice 3-Way Match Trigger on a posted GRN and record whether it is refused or absent, then repeat as an AP Executive and record whether the trigger is available and any tenant RBAC configuration

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach GRN, invoice matching, role administration, or the required alternate user sessions.
Assert that the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester's role comparison; this does not replace the missing GRN authorization assertion.
